completeProposedProcedure.NEW_application: One willing perceived creature including self;60elapsed seconds, no concentration. No RP-pool prerequisite for learning a quote. One active record per beneficiary. No arbitrary rank/query-count cap; while operative the beneficiary can form one precisely specified inquiry at a time without an Action, only during a genuine decision window, never interrupting an indivisible transaction. Responses are private to beneficiary.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_query: Identify one actual source identity/version and mode plus actor/provider, class-level/rank, extras/metamagic choices, actual position/time/environment and contemplated real permissions. Own context is authorized; foreign private actor context needs actual informed cooperation. Public identified spell cost may be queried hypothetically without learning its formula or acquiring access. Missing operative source/rank/context operands returns unresolved, not an invented number. Distinguish no RP interface, exact0, known positive but unaffordable, and illegal casting with separately computable hypothetical price.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_quote: At query resolution snapshot the specified current context. Return exact ordinary total after real class/minima, this Matrix waiver, Nexus, Dampening and final Influence; separately show actual protected RP principal/other costs and legality/affordability only where requester already has authorized personal/cooperative pool knowledge. Include Ready history as already paid with0new release fee. No casting, reservation, Influence consumption, use expenditure, Dissonance or prospective concentration transition occurs; hypothetical new concentration prices from the predicted post-transition state. Quote is not future lock: later movement, strain or interruption requires new actual price.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_information: Reveal useful total including otherwise hidden applicable cost adjustments when the actual context is authorized; no modifier count/name/location/caster-currentRP/private repertoire/formula follows from a total. Independently genuine information defenses apply only to their real scope. If they make the requested total unreadable/unresolved, use the same neutral “No determinate quote in this context” without exposing protection existence/counts. Preserve independently authorized separate inquiries. Missing history is not0cost. Actual antimagic can suppress Mastery; pending Mind Blank is not assumed acquired or operational. No divination comparison becomes a global privacy rule.

sharedSpellLocalRules.classification: NEW completions govern only these six proposed identities. Exact accepted interfaces are included as evidence, not amended globally.
sharedSpellLocalRules.casting: Use the actual native classAccess row, acquired repertoire and class engine. All six are rank8/base21RP/minimum class15. Core-compatible Action/120ft/V,S,F is retained; Furnace explicitly selects its historical alias below. Perceive legal targets/point with line of effect; total cover blocks. Actual speech, usable gesture hand and owned class focus are required. No generic upcast. Preflight legality/affordability precedes Action, RP/material/use commitment, concentration transition and chronological Dissonance/Refrain. Counter windows follow; miss/save/counter/late failure refunds nothing and restores no old concentration. No created effect retroactively modifies its own creation price.
sharedSpellLocalRules.geometry: NEW six-spell-local geometry uses feet and the accepted horizontal grid metric extended explicitly to 3D: D=max(|dx|,|dy|,|dz|). Range uses caster position to target foot/point. Matrix membership means a positive-volume intersection of actual occupied body interior and the closed grid-metric sphere; exact mere surface contact is not membership. Center-to-body line of effect clips eligibility. No proxy/familiar origin substitutes for original casting body. This is not a global metric amendment. NEW six-spell-local fixture body convention: actor foot is the southwest lower corner at ground contact; bodyFeet [w,d,h] gives occupied bounds [x,x+w]×[y,y+d]×[z,z+h], with body interior used for positive-volume intersection. A sphere touching only a body surface has zero intersecting volume and does not qualify. This is local to these authored data fixtures and does not amend global grid or combat geometry.
sharedSpellLocalRules.clock: Selected one-minute effects last 60 elapsed seconds from successful application, explicit absolute endpoints retained through extra turns, death, reordering and initiative transitions. Expiry at equality precedes new eligibility. Concentration ends on actual loss/incapacitation/death; nonconcentration records persist after creator death unless their own target/lifecycle ends. Effects are magical spell applications with generating rank8 and ordinary dispel interfaces, not physical objects. Actual Wizard class Dispel is rank3/3RP, INT+PB vs18 for these effects; no assumed Greater Dispel acquisition.
sharedSpellLocalRules.suppression: Actual applicable suppression suspends an application, never clocks, counters, causal credit, receipt ledgers or prior outcomes. No queued RP, missed interception, retroactive waiver or delayed information. An already committed lawful payment is history. Reentry/recast requires its own current checks. Native suppression input/output and no same-cast rescan rules remain exact.
sharedSpellLocalRules.resources: RP pools and maxima stay per actual identity, separate from HP/temp/form buffers, RC, charges, components and uses. Positive RP charges require a real personal RP pool and actual funds. Credits clip at actual maximum; waste is recorded and not banked. No transaction is replayable by changing cast/application IDs; preserve original causal root, payer, receiver and actual price allocation. Cast copies retain their own exact no-copy/no-resource restrictions; rank8 payloads are outside accepted Fate Echo rank0..7 and cannot be copied by it.
sharedSpellLocalRules.replacement: For Shield/Furnace one operative same-name application per recipient; a successful new application replaces the old even with another owner, without refund or copying counters. Nullification retains one per target, successful new failure-save application replaces; success creates none and leaves prior valid record. Mastery has one per beneficiary, successful new one replaces. Matrix one concentration field per caster, overlapping fields grant one waiver total. Starting same-owner concentration replacement ends the old at commitment even if countered. Stale cleanup addresses only its exact application ID.
sharedSpellLocalRules.holds: Authored conditional actor encounters are not established campaign events. Missing real external damage/transfer/Null/form/hazard/defense/item/ancestry profiles remain whole-case or branch holds, with no synthetic source acquisition. All current inherited qualifications are retained verbatim in authority/latest_accepted and the exact source packet.
sharedSpellLocalRules.concentrationInvariant: NEW local data invariant for the six proposed Rank8 identities and explicitly named concentration-support cards: each non-ended concentration-dependent application with concentrationOwner P is linked by P.actors[P].concentration to exactly that application; one owner has at most one such live link. Another actor's application never clears P's unrelated concentration. A true ending marks the exact application ended and clears only its concentrationOwner link if that link points to the ending application. Suppression does not sever concentration. This is scoped case-data bookkeeping, not a global class or spell rule.

completeProposedProcedure.KEEP: Choose3 actual RP-using spellcasters; each recovers cost of one Tier5-or-lower spell they can cast. Explicit L01-A current-book priority; Core flat10 and broader three-spellcaster wording retained as conflicting evidence. Tier means actual native generating spell rank0..5 for this NEW local completion, never characterlevel or paidRP.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_targets: Exactly three distinct willing living perceived beneficiaries with real independently acquired RP pools, within120feet and line of effect; self allowed once. Oracle RC-only is ineligible. Each must have at least one actual acquired operational spell route of rank0..5 and unused Leyline receipt entitlement. Each selects their reference at declaration; absent choice means no legal declaration. Creature names do not grant pools, repertoire, custody or cosmology.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_reference: Choose one genuinely possessed legal learned/prepared/class/native temporary route with an ordinary BASE RP-price interface and actual native rank0..5. Acquisition/preparation must exist, but current depleted funds, spent Action, Dissonance/Nullification or other temporary use restriction does not remove a possessed reference; record such restriction separately. Select printed actual native base RP price, including a class card’s true replacement base, before ANY optional extra, protectedprincipal, discount, waiver, Nexus, Matrix, Influence, Dampening or strain. Rank0base0 is allowed but yields0; no-interface charge-only/RC reference is ineligible. Snapshot that source and base at commitment, revalidate actual identity/grant at resolution; reference is never cast, learned, countered, paid or exhausted.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_award: NEW explicit anti-repeat receipt limit, selected L04-B: one Leyline Flow receipt attempt per actual identity across all casters/classes/copies since that identity’s actual beneficial completed long rest. This is new spell-local authorship, not inherited Well law. At legal cast commitment atomically reserve/consume each of the three actual receipt uses, even if countered or later prevented; existing uses cannot be borrowed/reset by replacement, suppression, copying or Matrix. No separate caster daily cap. At resolution independently recheck each original recipient living/consent/range/line/grant. Each remaining branch credits its snapped base once, capped at that pool maximum; lost/blocked/overfull branch is wasted, no retarget/refund or shared reservoir. Valid siblings still resolve. Self recovery happens after real21cost, not financing it retroactively.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_consequences: A native paid rank5-reference cast can recover30for21 group delta+9; this is an explicit useful finite creation, not conservation. Matrix may waive the21but does not erase intrinsic recovery or receipt limit; repeated same recipients are ineligible before any second payment. Different actual unused recipients can benefit; eventual real beneficial long rests refresh only their own source-qualified ledger. Bound rest/cadence/strain and actual identities remain necessary; no infinite-loop or balance claim follows. Shield can intercept a recipient branch, spending that Leyline receipt while only actually paid root base funds bounded Shield recovery. Furnace/Conduit remain distinct transactions. Name grants no actual leyline access/map.
